events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese's 87th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles gave us the iconic 'White Album'. What's your favourite track from this double LP masterpiece?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched, truly a legend gone too soon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Widely considered a pivotal album, it showed the band's evolving sound.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, a visionary artist whose impact on music and peace continues to resonate worldwide.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the iconic and influential musician David Bowie.

angles.name: David Bowie Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator who constantly redefined artistry.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Presley Tribute
angles.copy: Happy would-have-been 92nd birthday to the one and only Elvis Presley! His music still shakes, rattles, and rolls us.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page's 83rd
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro of the fretboard, Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped generations of rock music.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod Stewart's 82nd
angles.copy: Raise a glass! Sir Rod Stewart is 82 today. Still rocking after all these years, what's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs' 66th
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! Here's to more 'One Step Beyond' moments from the Madness legend.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful voice of Paul Young! Still got that 'Love of the Common People' for him.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Today would have been the 81st birthday of the legendary country music superstar Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible life and music of Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her songs and spirit continue to shine.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary Barlow's 56th
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo success, he's given us so many unforgettable tunes.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's 77th
angles.copy: Get out of our dreams and into our cars to wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday! A true soul and R&B legend.

events.title: First Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: 38 years ago today, rock history was made with the very first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who was your favourite from that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen's 55th
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still bringing the charm and the tunes after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the roof of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Concert
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles played their legendary final live performance on a London rooftop. An iconic moment in music history!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning musician, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a hugely successful solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil Collins' 76th
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to 'In The Air Tonight', his influence is undeniable.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies and dramas, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Hugh Grant's 67th
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the effortlessly charming Hugh Grant! From Notting Hill to Love Actually, he's a true British icon.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake's 46th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From 'N Sync to solo superstardom, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure and beloved British actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: David Jason's 87th
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! From Del Boy to Pop Larkin, he's given us so many iconic characters.

events.title: The Day The Music Died (1959)
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper today, 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, famous for his 80s hits and internet phenomenon 'Rickrolling', celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Rick Astley's 61st
angles.copy: Never gonna give him up! Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley. What's your favourite tune from the 80s icon?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Today would have been the 82nd birthday of the legendary reggae musician and cultural icon Bob Marley.

angles.name: Bob Marley Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. One love, one heart.
